question: Does reusable CPU meet-in-the-middle decomposition preserve complete recovery certificates, and where does complete CPU recovery spend work?

claims.text: CPU cached, batched and reference oracles return byte-identical complete recovery certificates on the fixed panel.
Cached oracle tables are built once per distinct trial base; batched subtraction uses at most one inversion per nonempty batch with ordinary additions.
L0 timings do not establish certified speedup, external-tool or rho advantage, asymptotic improvement, unknown-scalar challenge performance or largest feasible scale.

arms.description: Cached MITM with individual inversions, batch=1 ablation

parameters.oracle: Cached MITM with individual inversions, batch=1 ablation

positive.not_applicable_reason: Each fixed public target is constructed from a known scalar before solver invocation; solver sees only P,Q. Exact recovery and independent replay must pass every execution.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Every execution corrupts the recovered scalar after timing and requires rejection. All-target unit tests also compare exhaustive positive and negative relation answers; no random-population claim.

factors.name: source_and_build
factors.value: One frozen source commit and standalone optimized Rust binary
factors.how: Original reduction included verbatim; only oracle variant changes. Capture rustc and hashes.

factors.name: inputs
factors.how: Public software fixtures; seeds111,222,333; max_trials16,max_work1000000,one target per execution.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Same EKS job, CPU2,memory4Gi; one software thread per cell; shared VM L0. Capture CPUinfo, affinity, kernel, cgroups. No certified clocks.

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.how: Fresh process per cell; cap1000000 retained tuple rows. Record retained sum-table bytes, not RSS. No reuse between complete recoveries.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Latin four-arm rotation with alternating reversal by round and case.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen Rust analyzer reads neutral labels and exact full certificate bytes; labels decoded in report.

seed_derivation.note: seed=111*(case+1), fixed across arms and rounds. Target scalar construction is solely a public known-answer fixture and excluded from solver inputs.

instance_sampling.rule: Three fixed complete-recovery software fixtures, covering 8/16-bit fields and 3/4 slots; no population or scale extrapolation.

blinding.how: Standalone frozen analyzer receives neutral u/v/w/x labels and cert files only; producer knows key. Numerical signatures may reveal variants.

power.note: Exact source-level counts and deterministic equality need no sampling power. Nine repeats characterize descriptive ranges only; no timed significance test or equivalence claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured conservative allocation, not evidence. Round0 is fixed per-arm/case warmup/preflight. No timing data existed at freeze.

primary.name: Reusable table preparations
primary.definition: Cumulative successful preparation count, including discarded trials; original reference emits0 because it has no reusable table. Not an equal-cost operation unit across algorithms.

primary.name: Residual batch inversions
primary.definition: Inversions used computing target-minus-prefix residuals in cached variants, includes work after earliest hit inside computed batch. Excludes table build, base enumeration, replay and elimination. Reference emits0 meaning uninstrumented, not no inversions.

secondary.name: complete_ms
secondary.definition: Fresh-process algorithm interval: curve construction and known-target construction, solve including all base/table setup, discarded trials, target queries, reduction and internal verification, second independent replay, certificate serialization. Excludes process launch, archive I/O and negative control. Not the primary IC-online interval.
secondary.resolution: Rust Instant, nanosecond representation; effective host precision not established

secondary.name: oracle_ms
secondary.definition: All oracle queries, including cold table preparation, discarded trials and witness checks.
secondary.resolution: Rust Instant, nanosecond representation; effective host precision not established

secondary.name: bases_ms
secondary.definition: All base enumeration across all trials.
secondary.resolution: Rust Instant, nanosecond representation; effective host precision not established

secondary.name: reduction_other_ms
secondary.definition: Solve remainder excluding bases and oracle: target generation, elimination, scalar recovery and internal replay; not a pure linear-algebra timer.
secondary.resolution: Rust Instant, nanosecond representation; effective host precision not established

secondary.name: curve_ms
secondary.resolution: Rust Instant, nanosecond representation; effective host precision not established

secondary.name: replay_ms
secondary.resolution: Rust Instant, nanosecond representation; effective host precision not established

record: CPUinfo, kernel, process affinity and cgroups
all stage durations and cumulative structural counters

placement.binary_source: separately pinned source commit; staged standalone CPU binary, not an ecbench plug-in

stopping_rules.rule: 4arms x3instances x(1warmup+9rounds)=120 rows; no extra repeats after viewing results.
Any incorrect output, timeout or missing cell invalidates panel; preserve failures. Per-cell60s, whole job900s, one attempt, no automatic reruns.

invalidation_rules: Any full certificate mismatch, missing/duplicate cell, failed known scalar or negative replay, source/hash mismatch or deadline invalidates the panel.

decision_rule.text: C1 requires full certificate byte equality, all complete recoveries and corrupted-scalar rejection. C2 is exact implementation/counter evidence, not a total-work advantage. Timings descriptive L0 only.
decision_rule.threshold: All fixed cells complete with identical certificates; expected batching and reuse counters are consistent.
decision_rule.statistic: exact certificate equality and structural counters; descriptive stage median/min/max
decision_rule.interval: exact counts; diagnostic full observed range, no confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Structural query counts and descriptive stage times only. Matched rho and fastest external comparisons not run; their gaps remain unknown.

graphs: Per-arm complete CPU recovery diagnostic median and full observed range

inadmissible: Calling retained table capacity total peak memory
Calling cached MITM tensor contraction or algebraic progress
Claiming largest feasible scale or rho/external advantage without matched measurements

literature.claim: Bernstein and Lange describe standard affine arithmetic and precomputation/batch inversion tradeoffs; this code applies known methods, no novelty claim.
literature.verified_by: Primary paper read before implementation,2026-10-30 UTC

literature.claim: Existing reduction, checked group operations, lexicographic exhaustive oracle and independent verifier define exact output semantics.
